---
title: "ihc_optimisation_results"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(glue)
library(readxl)

project_dir <- "~/Documents/repos/explant-seq"

df <- read_excel(glue("{project_dir}/data/260729_IHC_optimisation_results.xlsx"))
df$group <- paste(df$sample, df$block, sep = "_")
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

df_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(group, secondary, channel) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(`mean intensity`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_val   = sd(`mean intensity`, na.rm = TRUE),
    n        = sum(!is.na(`mean intensity`)),
    sem_val  = sd_val / sqrt(n),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

channel_colors = c(
  "Cy3_560" = "#EC008C",
  "Cy5_640" = "#00AEEF",
  "Alexa488" = "#50C878")

# Plot
dodge_width <- 0.9  # must match between geom_bar and geom_errorbar to align

p <- ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = secondary, y = mean_val, fill = channel)) +
  geom_bar(position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), stat = "identity") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_val - sem_val, ymax = mean_val + sem_val),  # swap sem_val for sd_val if preferred
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    width = 0.25
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = channel_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Secondary",
    y = "Mean intensity",
    fill = "Channel"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p)
```
